jobs.title: Senior Food Auditor
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — food industry auditing requires a food technology degree, 5+ years in food production, and specific third-party auditing certifications (IFS/BRC) the candidate does not hold. Also requires Dutch fluency, which the candidate lacks. Multiple hard ineligibility triggers.

jobs.title: Food Assessor
jobs.reason: This is a food industry quality assurance auditor role requiring a food industry degree, IFS/BRC audit qualifications, and 3+ years' experience in food production — none of which the candidate has. It also requires Czech language fluency, which triggers a hard ineligibility. Complete mismatch with the candidate's IR/policy profile.

jobs.title: Freelance Aerospace Auditor
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a technical aerospace quality-management auditing role requiring an engineering/science degree, 5+ years in the aerospace industry, and AS9100 audit experience, none of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility on the 5-year aerospace experience requirement and Dutch-language work requirement (candidate does not speak Dutch).

jobs.title: Freelance Quality and VCA Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Mismatch on every dimension: this is an ISO9001/VCA quality and safety management auditor role requiring a technical degree, qualified Lead Auditor credentials, MVK safety qualification, fluent Dutch, and minimum 5 years' industry experience — all hard requirements the candidate does not meet. Triggers multiple hard ineligibility rules (5+ years required, specialist certifications, Dutch fluency).

jobs.title: Freelance Auditor Integrated Systems
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a technical ISO management systems auditor role requiring a qualified third-party Lead Auditor certification, an engineering degree, minimum 5 years' experience, and Dutch fluency. Multiple hard ineligibility triggers: 5+ years required, Dutch language required for the work (candidate has only A1), and specialist auditing qualifications the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.reason: Although adverse media screening has tangential links to OSINT/risk analysis, this is a senior data science role requiring a solid applied ML/NLP track record, deep expertise in TensorFlow/PyTorch, big data pipelines, and team leadership — well beyond the candidate's basic Python familiarity and pre-professional stage. Hard ineligibility on seniority given the leadership and applied-DS experience requirements.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor
jobs.reason: This is a social compliance auditor role requiring 3-4 years of specialised auditing experience, ideally APSCA/SA8000 certification, which the candidate lacks. The field (factory compliance auditing) is only tangentially related to the candidate's IR/human rights interests, and the role requires specific vocational auditing skills rather than research/policy expertise.

jobs.title: CMMC Certified Assessor (CCA)
jobs.reason: This is a cybersecurity compliance assessor role requiring active CCP/CCA certifications, additional cybersecurity credentials (CISSP/CISM/etc.), 3+ years cybersecurity experience, US citizenship, and DoD security clearance — none of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility on multiple counts (specialist certifications, citizenship requirement, years of experience).

jobs.title: Food Safety Auditor - Denmark
jobs.reason: Pure mismatch — food safety auditing for retail clients is unrelated to IR, policy, or intelligence work. The role requires a Lead Auditor qualification (ISO22k/ISO45k), 3 years of retail/supply auditing experience, and a food science/Environmental Health background, none of which the candidate holds.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Cyber APAC
jobs.reason: This is a cybersecurity sales/account management role requiring cold-calling, CRM pipeline management, and revenue delivery — unrelated to the candidate's research/policy focus. Hard ineligibility triggers: explicit minimum of 5 years' experience, and Cantonese/Japanese/Korean strongly preferred for the target markets (candidate has none).
